expo.name: MoodMap AI
expo.description:
MoodMap AI is your personal emotional intelligence companion — a beautifully designed app that helps you understand how the places you go, the people you're with, and the things you do shape the way you feel every day.

In just 60 seconds, log your mood on a 1–10 scale, tag your activities, note who you're with, describe physical sensations, and optionally pin your location. Over time, MoodMap AI builds a rich, private picture of your emotional landscape and uses AI to surface the patterns you can't see on your own.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🗺️ EMOTIONAL MAP
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
See your mood data come alive on an interactive map. Color-coded markers show exactly where you felt your best — and where stress tends to find you. Switch to heatmap view for a bird's-eye picture of your emotional geography. Privacy blur keeps your exact locations private while preserving the insights.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🤖 AI INSIGHTS ENGINE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MoodMap AI analyzes your check-in history and delivers personalized, non-diagnostic observations:
• Emotional triggers — activities, places, and situations that consistently lift or lower your mood
• Emotional safe spaces — the locations where you feel most at ease
• Stress patterns — recurring situations that drain your energy
• Coping strategy recommendations — evidence-informed mindfulness exercises, breathing techniques, journaling prompts, and grounding practices tailored to your unique patterns

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📊 MOOD DASHBOARD
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Track your emotional journey with a clean, intuitive dashboard:
• 7-day mood trend chart
• Mood distribution breakdown (Great / Good / Neutral / Low)
• Daily check-in streak to keep you consistent
• Weekly AI-generated reports with highlights, top activities, and growth opportunities

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔔 SMART REMINDERS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Build a consistent check-in habit with customizable reminders. Set the times that fit your routine and MoodMap AI will gently nudge you to pause and reflect.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔒 PRIVACY FIRST — ALWAYS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Your emotional data is deeply personal. MoodMap AI is built with privacy at its core:
• All data is stored locally on your device — never on external servers
• Location data can be blurred so your exact position is never recorded
• GDPR and CCPA compliant
• Export your full data as JSON at any time
• Delete everything with a single tap

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHO IS MOODMAP AI FOR?
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MoodMap AI is for anyone who wants to:
✦ Build deeper self-awareness and emotional intelligence
✦ Understand how their environment affects their wellbeing
✦ Identify what drains them and what energizes them
✦ Make healthier, more intentional decisions every day
✦ Support their mental wellness journey alongside therapy or coaching

MoodMap AI is not a medical device and does not provide clinical diagnoses or treatment. It is a self-reflection and personal growth tool.

Download MoodMap AI today and start mapping the emotions that shape your life.
